counts.estimate_basis: single_image_visible_fruit (one viewpoint; occluded fruit are not counted)

assumptions.note: Manually configured assumptions; not measured by this system.

uncertainty_note: No uncertainty interval: no field-validation data configured (harvest.validation_pairs_path).
warnings: Maturity classification unavailable: maturity breakdown is not reported.
Visibility fraction not configured: total tree yield cannot be reliably inferred. Only observed (visible) quantities are reported.
limitations: Counts cover only fruit visible from the recorded viewpoint(s); occluded fruit are not counted.
A track id is not proof of a globally unique fruit: ID switches and merges occur.
Maturity labels describe visible appearance, not physiological maturity or operational harvest readiness.
Harvest values depend entirely on the configured calibration assumptions (probability, mean weight, visibility fraction).
No accuracy figure is implied; validate against manual counts and measured harvest weights.

definitions.raw_frame_detections: Every box the detector emitted in every processed frame (images: boxes before filtering). NOT a fruit count for videos.
definitions.confirmed_tracks: Video only: tracks seen in >= min_confirm_observations processed frames.
definitions.estimated_unique_visible_fruit: Policy-based estimate of distinct fruit visible in the footage (image: counted detections; video: confirmed tracks after review). Not ground truth.
definitions.estimated_total_tree_fruit: estimated_unique_visible_fruit / visibility_fraction. Present only when a visibility fraction is configured; the fraction is an assumption.
